name: DescribeInstanceList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Origin instances to query. Specify the value in the `["<Instance ID 1>","<Instance ID 2>",……]` format
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID列表。使用`["<实例ID 1>","<实例ID 2>",……]`格式表示
parameters.name: instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: The remark of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的备注。支持模糊查询
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return when paging is used
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of instances on each page when paging is used
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含实例的数量
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of the IP assets protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4 protocol.
IPv6: IPv6 protocol
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例防护的IP资产的协议类型。取值：

IPv4：表示IPv4协议。
IPv6：表示IPv6协议
parameters.name: ip_version

parameters.help_en:
The mitigation plan type of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Valid values:

0: Professional.
1: Enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的防护套餐类型。取值：

0：表示专业版。
1：表示企业版
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the protected object for the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的防护对象IP
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The field used to sort the Anti-DDoS Origin instance list. The value is fixed as expireTime, which indicates that instances are sorted by expiration time.

You can use the Orderdire parameter to specify the sort order
parameters.help_zh:
设置DDoS原生防护实例列表的排序字段。取值固定为expireTime，表示按照实例的到期时间排序。

您可以通过Orderdire参数设置排序方式。
parameters.name: orderby

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

desc (default): descending order by expiration time.
asc: ascending order by expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
设置排序方式。取值：

desc（默认）：表示按照到期时间降序排序。
asc：表示按照到期时间升序排序
parameters.name: orderdire

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html to query all region IDs supported by Anti-DDoS Origin
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
